steps.text: Tap the screen to continue the conversation.
Walk up to someone or something to interact.
This is your Book. You can use it to review important information about your journey.
Settings lets you adjust things like music, sound effects, and other game options.
The Quest page shows your current quests and achievements.
Rapport lets you check your relationships with the people you meet.
The Dictionary keeps track of words you have discovered during your journey.
The Map shows the places you have discovered and helps you keep track of the world.
